title: Barbell Overhead Squat
description:
1. Select a manageable load, clear the area, and take a stable starting position for Barbell Overhead Squat.
2. Lock the bar securely overhead, keep it stacked over the midfoot, and squat while the knees track over the toes and the torso stays braced.
3. Return the load under control and repeat for the programmed repetitions.
